shortDescription: According to Nikkei Asia, Volkswagen Group said on Wednesday that it signed a memorandum of understanding with India's JSW Group for a joint venture as part of a sweeping overhaul that could lead to 50,000 job cuts.

title: Volkswagen Group Signs JV Pact With India's JSW Group Amid Overhaul
